metadata.excluded_windows: Any missing surface or nonconsecutive session within a 23-observation window
metadata.time_labels: Declared 16:00 America/New_York closes; not observed release timestamps
metadata.label: multi-asset VolGAN adaptation
metadata.architecture: Joint G: Softplus 16, Softplus 32, affine; D: Softplus 16, sigmoid
metadata.feature_order: asset-major: sqrt252*latest_return, sqrt252*previous_return, RV21, maturity-major logIV
metadata.transition: one consecutive common exchange session; no dt rescaling
metadata.objective: 0.5 generator BCE + calibrated log-surface Sobolev penalties; discriminator mean real/fake BCE
metadata.history_sampling: first, final and every 100th epoch per phase
